profile.headline: Senior Dev at CCM | Founder of Code and Data Works, LLC
profile.summary:
Strategic Technical Leader | AI Engineering | Distributed Systems | Enterprise Data Architecture

With nearly 20 years of experience across Logistics, Retail, and Fintech, I specialize in bridging the gap between complex engineering hurdles and high-impact business outcomes. My career is defined by building fault-tolerant systems that scale, leading cross-functional teams across multiple countries, and driving significant cost savings through technical innovation.

Currently pursuing an M.S. in Artificial Intelligence Engineering, I am focused on pioneering "AI-Ready" architectures. I help organizations transition from legacy data silos to intelligent, predictive ecosystems by optimizing SQL environments and building high-velocity data pipelines.

Core Impact Areas:
• AI & Data Modernization: Architecting scalable SQL environments and ETL pipelines to support predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and "Internet of Medical Things" (IoMT) data flows.
• Distributed Systems at Scale: Led the migration of 70+ microservices at Walmart, significantly improving system uptime and developer productivity.
• Strategic Leadership: Managed global engineering teams (5+ countries) and delivered over $1.5 Million in savings through automated analytics and process optimization.
• Compliance & Security: Expert in maintaining data integrity and privacy within highly regulated industries, ensuring alignment with ISO 27001 and HIPAA-style frameworks.

Technical Toolkit:
• Languages & Frameworks: Python (Flask), Java (Spring Boot), JavaScript, C#, Microservices, Kafka.
• Cloud & DevOps: Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD (ArgoCD, Jenkins).
• Data Ecosystem: BigQuery, Cassandra, Cosmos DB, SQL Query Optimization, Power BI, Tableau.

I am passionate about mentoring the next generation of developers and leading mission-critical SDLC phases that enhance both deployment velocity and system security.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Lead SDLC phases for python projects from requirements analysis to deployment, improving delivery times.
• Pioneer technologies to improve security, performance, and scalability, boosting overall efficiency.
• Use Automation Anywhere to extract, transform and analyze data from SQL and CSV, streamlining processing tasks.
• Develop Qlik Cloud business intelligence apps, accelerating report generation and delivery.
• Improve Agile processes, contributing to software releases and enhancing team productivity.
• Mentor junior developers through best practices, leading to stronger, more maintainable code.
• Diagnose and resolve application issues, minimizing downtime and service disruptions.
• Automate data transformation, reporting, and notifications with Python, reducing manual workloads and errors.
• Design and optimize SQL queries (T-SQL), enhancing database performance and responsiveness.
• Align development with business goals, improving team coordination and stakeholder satisfaction.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Business Analytics · Qlik Sense · Robotic Process Automation (RPA) · Data Analytics · Logistics Management · Microsoft SQL Server · IT Business Analysis · Operations Management

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
As the founder of Code and Data Works, LLC, I am building an educational technology venture from the ground up. My focus is on creating a mobile-first learning experience to solve the problem of student disengagement in reading comprehension for 2nd-8th graders.

Our flagship product, LexiBubble, is an AI-powered application that generates unlimited, personalized stories and standards-based questions tailored to each child's grade level and unique interests.

Currently, I am:
- Leading the full product lifecycle, from ideation and market research to UI/UX design and final deployment.
- Programming the native Android application in Kotlin using Jetpack Compose.
- Engineering the secure, scalable backend using Firebase, Firestore, and Cloud Functions (TypeScript).
- Integrating generative AI through advanced prompt engineering to create dynamic, grade-appropriate educational content.
- Developing the business strategy, including the 2025 invite-only beta launch and the 2026 subscription-based go-to-market plan.

The LLC also serves as the entity for my independent consulting work in custom Android app development, cloud backend architecture, and software analytics.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Spearheaded REST API development for inventory management, focusing on scalability and high availability.
• Managed migration of 70+ microservices from F# to Java Spring Boot, applying principles of distributed system design. 
• Optimized microservices with Java, Kafka, and Cosmos, increasing speed, consistency, and efficiency. 
• Designed real-time dashboards with Prometheus, Grafana, and Splunk for proactive alerting and monitoring. 
• Boosted data visibility by migrating historical data from Cassandra to BigQuery, enhancing analytics and reporting. 
• Mentored junior developers, promoting skill development and best practices for a collaborative environment. 
• Cultivated engineering culture through knowledge sharing, collaboration, and modern engineering advocacy.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Kafka · NoSQL · Google BigQuery · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Kubernetes · Distributed Tracing · Postman API · Mockito · JUnit · Docker · Grafana · Prometheus · Splunk · Telemetry

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Designed and maintained scalable web apps using .NET (VB.Net, C#), boosting system reliability and performance. 
• Developed Power BI reports with row-level security, driving actionable insights for internal and Fortune 500 clients. 
• Analyzed business requirements with stakeholders, ensuring solutions met objectives and improved alignment. 
• Created and unit-tested applications per coding standards, enhancing performance and reducing error rates. 
• Integrated Open APIs to aggregate weather and hazard data, alerting clients and mitigating risks. 
• Automated customer processes, cutting manual workloads by 30% and boosting efficiency. 
• Diagnosed and resolved issues via root cause analysis, debugging code, and implementing long-term fixes. 
• Improved functionality by designing features, suggesting enhancements, and executing upgrades. 
• Estimated task durations accurately, delivering solutions on time and meeting milestones. 
• Applied object-oriented design principles to create robust, maintainable software solutions. 
• Stayed current with emerging technologies and trends, maintaining IT proficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · C# · Microsoft Power BI · Data Analytics · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Microsoft SQL Server · T-SQL Stored Procedures · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · DAX

positions.title: Analytics Engineer & Project Lead
positions.description:
• Designed and deployed data pipelines for 200K+ M2M devices, improving system monitoring and efficiency.
• Improved support workflows by automating data tasks and providing insights to senior management.
• Directed a cross-functional team across 5 countries and 6 time zones, coordinating project timelines.
• Managed stakeholder communications between technical and business teams, delivering $500K+ in annual savings.

• Developed API integrations for seamless data flow and optimized software design.
• Implemented synthetic data testing to resolve issues and ensure service availability.
• Created automated testing frameworks to ensure reliability, minimize downtime, and support incident response.
• Conducted performance tuning and diagnostics, enhancing platform stability and reducing disruptions.

volunteerExperiences.description: Stall Catchers is an online research platform participants look at movies of real blood vessels in mouse brains, and search for “stalls” – clogged capillaries where blood is no longer flowing. The research focus of Stall Catchers – the role of reduced blood flow in the brain – has shown promise in reducing and preventing Alzheimer’s symptoms.

organizations.name: American Communication Association
organizations.description: The ACA is a not-for-profit virtual professional association with actual presence in the world of communication scholars and practitioners. ACA is committed to enabling the effective use of new and evolving technologies to facilitate communication instruction, research and criticism, and to offering a technologically supportive venue for all who study the ways in which humans communicate.

organizations.name: CompTIA
organizations.description: The Computing Technology Industry Association (CompTIA) is an American non-profit trade association, issuing professional certifications for the information technology (IT) industry. It is considered one of the IT industry's top trade associations. Based in Downers Grove, Illinois, CompTIA issues vendor-neutral professional certifications in over 120 countries. The organization releases over 50 industry studies annually to track industry trends and changes.
